title: Silicon kit demo (engine test, no voice)
_note: Hand-made test for the silicon kit (26 Nov 2026): fake word timings in vo_words.json, silent vo.mp3. Chip markings are generic placeholders.

scenes.text: This is the logic board of an iPhone, and one chip does all the thinking.
scenes.visual: Board hero: full-bleed macro of the dense logic board (silicon kit LogicBoard in the phone chassis), light sweep, camera drifts to the SoC on 'chip'.

scenes.text: The processor is a package: memory stacked on the silicon, sitting on hundreds of solder balls.
scenes.visual: SoC package macro with etched marking; lifts on 'package', explodes into lid / memory / RDL / die / substrate / balls on 'stacked'.

scenes.text: Dive into the die, past the cores and the cache, down to one transistor switching.
scenes.visual: NanoZoom: package -> die floorplan -> core cell fabric -> one gate-all-around nanosheet transistor switching.

scenes.text: Next door, the modem and the wireless chip keep it connected.
scenes.visual: Upper board: modem + wireless chips with RF rings, camera eases modem -> wireless.
